notes: The main menu now checks for an update every time it opens and shows the result above the campaign list: up to date, downloading, ready to restart, or why the check failed. The desktop app and the web and iPad version both do this

The desktop app no longer gives up on an update for good when it was slow to start once. It now waits longer, retries a version that failed after 12 hours or when you check by hand, and times out a stalled download instead of hanging
Desktop app 1.62.0 has these fixes built in. Older desktop apps still get game updates
